plant.name: Offshore Gas Processing Train A
plant.description: High-pressure three-phase oil, gas, and water separation with two-stage compression.

hypotheses.name: Gas Control Valve (PCV-101) Stuck Closed / Actuator Air Failure
hypotheses.description: PCV-101 valve trim is mechanically stuck or pneumatic supply pressure failed, restricting gas outflow and building high vessel pressure.

hypotheses.name: Gas Control Valve (PCV-101) Stuck Open
hypotheses.description: PCV-101 failed fully open, causing uncontrolled depressurization of separator V-101.

hypotheses.name: Separator Foaming and Liquid Carryover into Demister Pad
hypotheses.description: Crude oil surfactant foaming and high superficial vapor velocity cause liquid droplet entrainment, blinding demister pad and flooding suction scrubber V-102.

hypotheses.name: Stage 1 Centrifugal Compressor (K-101) Aerodynamic Surge
hypotheses.description: Flow starved below surge limit line or anti-surge valve ASV-101 failed to recycle, producing aerodynamic flow reversal and destructive high shaft vibration.

hypotheses.name: Emulsion Rag Layer Growth and Interface Transmitter (LT-102) Drift
hypotheses.description: Intermediate emulsion rag layer creates dielectric and density gradient errors, causing LT-102 to read low while water accumulates in oil compartment.

hypotheses.name: Transient Upstream Wellhead Slugging Influx
hypotheses.description: Pipeline liquid accumulation intermittently surges into separator, causing cyclical simultaneous swings in pressure and liquid levels.

hypotheses.name: Nominal Steady-State Production Operation
hypotheses.description: All process variables, control valves, and compressor parameters operating within safe design envelopes.

checks.name: Inspect Local PCV-101 Valve Stem & Actuator Position
checks.instructions: Verify physical stem travel indicator against control room command percentage (e.g. 50% requested vs 10% actual indicates mechanical binding).

checks.name: Check Instrument Air Supply Pressure to PCV-101 Positioner
checks.instructions: Verify local air regulator gauge reads between 4.0 - 5.5 barg. Low air pressure prevents valve from holding open.

checks.name: Check Demister Differential Pressure Gauge & Drain Lines
checks.instructions: Confirm local differential pressure impulse lines are not liquid-filled; inspect scrubber sight glass for rapid liquid accumulation.

checks.name: Take Manual Thief Sample from V-101 Interface Try-Cocks
checks.instructions: Draw sample from middle test cock (sample point SP-102) to verify physical height of emulsion rag layer versus transmitter reading.

checks.name: Inspect Anti-Surge Recycle Valve ASV-101 Fast-Stroke Actuator
checks.instructions: Verify ASV-101 positioner response; confirm solenoid trip valve is energized and bypass line is hot to touch.

checks.name: Inspect V-102 Suction Scrubber Boot Auto-Drain Valve
checks.instructions: Check that scrubber drain valve LCV-103 is cycling to prevent liquid entry into compressor suction.

checks.name: Inspect Compressor Suction Strainer Differential Pressure
checks.instructions: Verify suction strainer DP is below 0.35 bar to rule out upstream particulate debris flow blockage.

actions.name: Switch PCV-101 to Manual Station / Crack Open Manual Bypass Valve
preconditions: Operator stationed locally at bypass valve

actions.name: Start Antifoam Chemical Injection Pump P-105 at 45 ppm
Trigger Manual Fast-Opening of Anti-Surge Valve ASV-101
Isolate and Flush LT-102 External Level Bridle with Hot Condensate
Pinch Upstream Production Wellhead Chokes by 15%
Crack Open High-Pressure Relief Flare Valve BDV-101
preconditions: Flare header lit and purged with fuel gas

documents.title: Standard Operating Procedure: Separator V-101 Pressure Management & Overpressure
documents.section: Section 2: High Pressure Handling & Relief Interlocks
documents.summary: Mandates that when PT-101 exceeds 34 barg, operator must cross-check PCV-101 stem travel before cracking manual bypass or venting to HP flare header.

documents.title: Standard Operating Procedure: Separator Foaming Mitigation & Demister Cleaning
documents.section: Section 4: Antifoam Dosing & Scrubber Flooding Prevention
documents.summary: Prescribes starting antifoam pump P-105 immediately when DP-101 exceeds 0.40 bar, and draining V-102 suction scrubber to avoid compressor liquid ingestion.

documents.title: Standard Operating Procedure: Centrifugal Compressor K-101 Anti-Surge Control
documents.section: Section 1: Surge Recovery & Vibration Trip Prevention
documents.summary: Mandates that if shaft vibration ST-101 rises above 4.5 mm/s or surge margin drops below 10%, anti-surge recycle valve ASV-101 must be immediately modulated open.

documents.title: Standard Operating Procedure: Oil-Water Interface Level Transmitter Maintenance
documents.section: Section 5: Bridle Flushing & Emulsion Pad Clearing
documents.summary: Requires periodic manual thief sampling to verify rag layer depth when LT-102 disagrees with oil export water-cut analyzer readings.

documents.title: Standard Operating Procedure: Pipeline Liquid Slug Reception & Choke Throttling
documents.section: Section 2: Slug Catching and Choke Manifold Throttling
documents.summary: Instructs control room operator to throttle manifold choke valves upon early acoustic detection of incoming liquid slugs.

documents.title: HAZOP Study Node 1: High Pressure Separator V-101
documents.summary: Identifies PCV-101 failure and demister plugging as major causes for vessel overpressurization and downstream scrubber carryover.

documents.title: HAZOP Study Node 2: Stage 1 Gas Compressor K-101
documents.summary: Identifies compressor surge as high-consequence failure mode leading to seal rupture, impeller clash, and catastrophic shutdown.
